consolidated_results.title: Visual Merchandising Coordinator
consolidated_results.notes: ATS detected; posted_date not visible on job detail page; apply CTA present; full JD extracted.
consolidated_results.jd:
Excellence in Visual Merchandising Implementation
Support the implementation of visual merchandising strategy in boutiques and points of sales following the VM Global guidelines aligned to the local strategy through teamwork with VM Ambassadors and VM POS partners by visiting the points of sale and giving training and coaching under the supervision and responsibility of the VM Manager. Coordinate and supervise external agencies and suppliers ensuring excellence in execution during installation and dismantling phases.

Coordinate the flow of materials between international and local suppliers, warehouse, and points of sale (6 boutiques/32 watch corners). Ensure the correct and timely delivery of visual merchandising material and tools to the points of sale. Supervise the correct installation and removal of visual merchandising material and tools in the points of sale.

Support the VM Manager in the preparation and execution of visual merchandising projects, events, and campaigns. Prepare and update visual merchandising guidelines and manuals for the points of sale. Ensure the correct implementation of visual merchandising guidelines and standards in the points of sale.

Monitor and report on the status of visual merchandising in the points of sale. Identify and propose improvements to visual merchandising processes and tools. Support the VM Manager in the training and development of the VM Ambassadors and POS partners.

Profile
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Design, Architecture, or related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in visual merchandising, preferably in the luxury retail sector. Strong organizational and project management skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a team and under pressure. Availability to travel. Fluent in English and Spanish.
